raw_sections.experience:
WORK EXPERIENCE
RPA Consultant – Barclays (Jun 2025 – Present)
Developed and deployed RPA solutions using UiPath Studio and Orchestrator, improving operational efficiency by ~30%.
Executed Python scripting built custom libraries, reducing manual effort by 25%.
Managed solution packaging, versioning, and CI/CD pipelines, following ALM best practices aligned with Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions workflows. 

Built chatbot solutions using LLMs and vector databases.
Prepared SDD and PDD documentation using Confluence.
Used Jira for SDLC-based task management.
Implemented Power Automate and Power Platform integrations using Dataverse to enable scalable automation workflows aligned with enterprise standards.
RPA Developer – EY (Jul 2022 – Jun 2025)
Designed conversational automation solutions on the Microsoft Power Platform, aligning closely with Copilot Studio capabilities, including orchestration via Power Automate and Dataverse-backed responses. 

Worked with SAP, Mainframe, Web, Desktop automation, and Document Understanding.
Built Canvas and Model-driven apps.
Integrated with Dataverse, SharePoint, SQL Server.
Senior RPA Developer – FIS (Jan 2021 – Jul 2022)
Designed RPA automation strategies.
Configured, validated, and monitored workflows.
Developed RPA solutions using UiPath, Python, and C#.
RPA Developer – Eze Castle Integration (Jun 2020 – Jul 2021)
Automation strategy formulation and monitoring of workflows.
